title: Összefoglalás: Az Osztrák–Magyar Monarchia (Austria-Hungary Consolidation)
grammar: Consolidation of the Austro-Hungarian Dual Monarchy & the Belle Époque

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can review the people, places and events of Austria-Hungary between 1867 and 1918.
I can say which affairs were common in the Monarchy and what happened to it in 1918.
I can name the Millennium monuments, the Parliament and the Ganz works.
